name: OneStream Live
what_it_is: A cloud-based live streaming platform that sends one live stream to several destinations at once, from a browser, an encoder or pre-recorded videos.
platforms: Browser-based Live Studio; external encoders via RTMP, RTMPS, SRT and WHIP (works with OBS, Zoom, vMix, Wirecast); mobile apps for iOS and Android; destinations include YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Kick, Steam, Amazon Live and custom RTMP
pricing: Free $0 forever (2 multistreaming destinations, 720p, 1 GB storage, 3 scheduled events); Basic $15/month or $144/year; Standard $39/month or $384/year; Professional $49/month or $468/year; Enterprise $99/month or $996/year. Prices are shown with a $ sign and the currency is not named.
key_features: Live Studio (browser-based streaming with guests, overlays and screen sharing)
External encoder support (RTMP, RTMPS, SRT, WHIP)
Stream players and custom branded websites
notable: Free plan: 2 destinations at once, live up to 1 hour per session or pre-recorded up to 15 minutes, no credit card required
Logos on the home page include OPPO, Hyundai, Vivo, British Council, Cartoon Network and Disney
180 and 360 degree video is available on paid plans

facts.fact: OneStream Live Inc. is named as the company in the copyright footer of the vendor site.
OneStream Live describes itself as a cloud-based live streaming platform that streams to several destinations at the same time.
The pricing page lists a Free plan at $0 forever with 2 multistreaming destinations, 720p streaming and 1 GB storage.

The pricing page lists paid plans Basic at $15 per month, Standard at $39 per month, Professional at $49 per month and Enterprise at $99 per month, with yearly billing shown at $144, $384, $468 and $996 per year.
The pricing page does not name the currency for its $ prices.

name: Livepush
what_it_is: A cloud-based live streaming platform that describes itself as 'The live streaming platform that stays on air', multistreaming to many destinations and hosting live events with a branded player.
platforms: Multistreaming to 40+ destinations including YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, Kick, LinkedIn, X and custom RTMP (FAQ also lists Vimeo, Dailymotion, TikTok, Rumble, DLive, Trovo and BiliBili); ingest via RTMP, SRT, pull URLs and browser camera or screen sharing; embeddable HTML5 player
pricing: Free plan with 20 streaming hours a month and no credit card required. Paid plans from $13/month billed yearly ($15/month billed monthly), according to the FAQ. Named tiers include Creators, Business, Studio and Enterprise; the page gives no price per tier.
key_features: Branded live event player with HLS and DASH playback
Pre-recorded live with scheduling, playlists and 24/7 looping
notable: Logos on the home page include BBC, Al Jazeera, NBCUniversal, Associated Press, AFP, Cisco, HubSpot, Vodafone, ZEISS and Harvard
The home page says 'Running streams in the cloud for broadcasters worldwide' with 'Since 2021' next to it, which describes service history, not a founding date
Streaming is delivered with Akamai, according to the home page

facts.fact: Livepush is operated by Streamflex Labs, Inc., according to the footer copyright line on the vendor site.
Livepush describes itself as a cloud-based live streaming platform with the tagline 'The live streaming platform that stays on air'.
Livepush offers a free plan with 20 streaming hours a month and states that no credit card is required.
The FAQ on the vendor site states paid plans from $13 per month billed yearly, or $15 per month billed monthly.
Livepush states it multistreams to 40+ destinations, including YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, Kick and LinkedIn.

name: Streamster
what_it_is: Free live streaming software with a cloud-based multistreaming feature and multi-device use, offered as a desktop app, in-browser multistream, mobile app and business studio.
platforms: Windows (desktop app), Mac, Android (Google Play), iOS (App Store), Microsoft Store, in-browser; multistreaming setups for PC, Mac, smartphone and GoPro
pricing: FREE $0 forever (2 channels, 720p/30); LITE $15/month (4 channels); REGULAR $30/month (6 channels, transcoding); PROFESSIONAL $50/month (8 channels, 2K/60); PREMIUM $75/month (10 channels, 4K/60). Pay-per-use plans from $0.48 to $1.92 per hour. No annual plans are shown. The currency is not named.
key_features: Multi-device workflow with a smartphone as remote
notable: The site says 'JOIN OVER 100 000 USERS'
VPN is included from the LITE plan upward
Pay-per-use option charges per hour

facts.fact: Streamster OÜ is named as the company in the footer copyright line on the vendor site.
Streamster describes itself as free live streaming software with cloud-based multistreaming and multi-device use.
The pricing page lists a FREE plan at $0 forever with 2 channels, and paid monthly plans LITE at $15, REGULAR at $30, PROFESSIONAL at $50 and PREMIUM at $75.
The pricing page lists pay-per-use plans charged per hour from $0.48 to $1.92, and shows no annual plans.
The vendor site lists Streamster apps for Windows, Mac, Android, iOS and Microsoft Store.

Facebook Live Video Solutions Partner (as stated on the home page)
